title: Network Repository Services; Stage 3 (NRF SBI)
summary: TS 29.510 defines the Network Repository Function services including NF Management and NF Discovery. In the 29.512 story, SMF uses Nnrf_NFDiscovery to find a PCF instance offering Npcf_SMPolicyControl before sending CreateSMPolicy.
defines: Nnrf_NFDiscovery — SearchNFInstances for target NF type
NF profile and service discovery query parameters
apiRoot resolution for discovered NF services
whyItMatters: CreateSMPolicy requires a reachable PCF apiRoot. SMF cannot call session policy blindly — NRF discovery is the step that connects SBI principles (29.501) to the actual policy API (29.512).

entryPoints.description: SMF searches for PCF instances offering Npcf_SMPolicyControl.

entryPoints.name: CreateSMPolicy
entryPoints.description: Policy call made after PCF is discovered.

entryPoints.name: NF service discovery
entryPoints.description: SBI discovery patterns from 29.501 applied via NRF.

interactions.description: Query for PCF with target-nf-type and service names

steps.action: PDU session establishment starts on SMF
SMF calls SearchNFInstances to discover PCF
SMF sends CreateSMPolicy to discovered PCF apiRoot
